description: Admin agents and the owner. Closes the company in 30 days: name confirms it with the company name. Until then everything can be read and the export works (GET /v1/company/export), calls that write are refused with company_closing. Then agents, people, sign-ins, sessions and wallets are removed. Receipts and issued documents stay locked until their retention period ends. cancel: true keeps the company. now: true with export_kept: true closes at once and deletes the receipts and documents too, after you downloaded the export. Documents in a seller's name stay with the seller.

cancel.description: true keeps the company: it cancels a closing that is scheduled

export_kept.description: With now: you downloaded the export and keep the records yourself

now.description: Close at once and delete everything

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: company.close
title: Close the company
